gaps.explanation: Statement (Exhibit H Totals 2025, trimmed p7) prints total operating expenses 433,122, which include Depreciation 43,678 (accrual-style net position statement). The detail line is Schedule 3 (trimmed p13) Proprietary disbursements 448,419 'Actual on Budgetary Basis' (budgetary cash basis), which excludes depreciation and includes the cash purchase of capital assets 8,975 (Water Fund, cash flow statement p8 / Totals p9) and the transfers to other funds 50,000 (p7 (50,000); p9). Arithmetic: 433,122 - 43,678 + 8,975 + 50,000 = 448,419 exactly. Gap -15,297 = -43,678 + 8,975 + 50,000. No detail line is wrong; the two printed totals are on different bases.
